reuse.reason: The official selector has no per-model unavailable state. The complete pinned browser fork preserves the Model / Effort menu, search, projections and provider ordering, adds visible disabled deployment capabilities, and rechecks the latest catalog at the shared composer and /model submission boundary. The command popup receives disabled/disabledReason through the separately tracked ui-commands compatibility fork. The existing official Effort row follows the Host catalog: off/low/high/max are selectable when execution supports them, while unavailable providers remain visible and disabled with eight-language explanations. The shared directory rechecks current capabilities before RPC.
gaps: The official selector is extended with explicit per-model and per-reasoning availability metadata. Unsupported provider capabilities remain visible and disabled; supported effort selection preserves the original official interaction.
